tsbs_iot.name: last-loc
tsbs_iot.description: Fleet map: the latest position of every truck in one fleet.
tsbs_iot.sql:
SELECT t.name, t.driver, r.longitude, r.latitude
FROM tags t
JOIN (SELECT tags_id, longitude, latitude,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tags_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn
      FROM readings) r ON r.tags_id = t.id AND r.rn = 1
WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL AND t.fleet = 'South'

tsbs_iot.name: low-fuel
tsbs_iot.description: Alert: trucks in one fleet whose latest fuel reading is below 10%.
tsbs_iot.sql:
SELECT t.name, t.driver, d.fuel_state
FROM tags t
JOIN (SELECT tags_id, fuel_state,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tags_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn
      FROM diagnostics) d ON d.tags_id = t.id AND d.rn = 1
WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL AND d.fuel_state < 0.1 AND t.fleet = 'South'

tsbs_iot.name: high-load
tsbs_iot.description: Alert: trucks in one fleet whose latest load is over 90% of their capacity.
tsbs_iot.sql:
SELECT t.name, t.driver, d.current_load
FROM tags t
JOIN (SELECT tags_id, current_load,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tags_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn
      FROM diagnostics) d ON d.tags_id = t.id AND d.rn = 1
WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL AND d.current_load / t.load_capacity > 0.9 AND t.fleet = 'South'

tsbs_iot.name: stationary-trucks
tsbs_iot.description: Trucks in one fleet that barely moved: an average speed under 1 over a 10-minute window.
tsbs_iot.sql:
SELECT t.name, t.driver
FROM tags t
JOIN readings r ON r.tags_id = t.id
WHERE r.time >= CAST('2026-01-03 12:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND r.time < CAST('2026-01-03 12:10:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND t.name IS NOT NULL AND t.fleet = 'South'
GROUP BY t.name, t.driver
HAVING avg(r.velocity) < 1

tsbs_iot.name: long-driving-sessions
tsbs_iot.description: Trucks in one fleet that drove in more than 22 of the 24 ten-minute windows of a 4-hour span.
tsbs_iot.sql:
SELECT t.name, t.driver
FROM tags t
JOIN (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 minutes', time) AS ten_minutes, tags_id
      FROM readings
      WHERE time >= CAST('2026-01-03 08:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND time < CAST('2026-01-03 12:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
      GROUP BY 1, 2
      HAVING avg(velocity) > 1) r ON t.id = r.tags_id
WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL AND t.fleet = 'South'
GROUP BY t.name, t.driver
HAVING count(r.ten_minutes) > 22

tsbs_iot.name: long-daily-sessions
tsbs_iot.description: Trucks in one fleet that drove in more than 60 ten-minute windows of a 24-hour span.
tsbs_iot.sql:
SELECT t.name, t.driver
FROM tags t
JOIN (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 minutes', time) AS ten_minutes, tags_id
      FROM readings
      WHERE time >= CAST('2026-01-02 12:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND time < CAST('2026-01-03 12:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
      GROUP BY 1, 2
      HAVING avg(velocity) > 1) r ON t.id = r.tags_id
WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL AND t.fleet = 'South'
GROUP BY t.name, t.driver
HAVING count(r.ten_minutes) > 60

tsbs_iot.name: avg-vs-projected-fuel-consumption
tsbs_iot.description: Per fleet, the average fuel consumption while moving against the trucks' nominal consumption.
tsbs_iot.sql:
SELECT t.fleet, avg(r.fuel_consumption) AS avg_fuel_consumption,
       avg(t.nominal_fuel_consumption) AS projected_fuel_consumption
FROM tags t
JOIN readings r ON r.tags_id = t.id
WHERE r.velocity > 1
  AND t.fleet IS NOT NULL AND t.nominal_fuel_consumption IS NOT NULL AND t.name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.fleet

tsbs_iot.name: avg-daily-driving-duration
tsbs_iot.description: Per truck, the average hours driven a day, counted in ten-minute windows.
tsbs_iot.sql:
WITH ten_minute_driving_sessions AS (
    SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 minutes', time) AS ten_minutes, tags_id
    FROM readings
    GROUP BY 1, 2
    HAVING avg(velocity) > 1
), daily_total_session AS (
    SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '24 hours', ten_minutes) AS day, tags_id, count(*) / 6.0 AS hours
    FROM ten_minute_driving_sessions
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT t.fleet, t.name, t.driver, avg(d.hours) AS avg_daily_hours
FROM daily_total_session d
JOIN tags t ON t.id = d.tags_id
GROUP BY t.fleet, t.name, t.driver

tsbs_iot.name: avg-daily-driving-session
tsbs_iot.description: Per truck and day, the average length of a driving session, from when it starts driving to when it stops.
tsbs_iot.sql:
WITH driver_status AS (
    SELECT tags_id, date_bin(INTERVAL '10 minutes', time) AS ten_minutes, avg(velocity) > 5 AS driving
    FROM readings
    GROUP BY 1, 2
), driver_status_change AS (
    SELECT tags_id, ten_minutes AS start_ts, date_part('epoch', ten_minutes) AS start_t,
           lead(date_part('epoch', ten_minutes)) OVER (PARTITION BY tags_id ORDER BY ten_minutes) AS stop_t, driving
    FROM (SELECT tags_id, ten_minutes, driving,
                 lag(driving) OVER (PARTITION BY tags_id ORDER BY ten_minutes) AS prev_driving,
                 lag(date_part('epoch', ten_minutes)) OVER (PARTITION BY tags_id ORDER BY ten_minutes) AS prev_t
          FROM driver_status) x
    WHERE x.prev_t > 0 AND x.driving <> x.prev_driving
)
SELECT t.name, date_bin(INTERVAL '24 hours', d.start_ts) AS day,
       avg(CASE WHEN d.stop_t > d.start_t THEN d.stop_t - d.start_t END) AS duration_s
FROM tags t
JOIN driver_status_change d ON t.id = d.tags_id
WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL AND d.driving = true
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

tsbs_iot.name: avg-load
tsbs_iot.description: Per fleet, model and capacity, the average load as a share of capacity.
tsbs_iot.sql:
SELECT t.fleet, t.model, t.load_capacity, avg(d.avg_load / t.load_capacity) AS avg_load_percentage
FROM tags t
JOIN (SELECT tags_id, avg(current_load) AS avg_load FROM diagnostics GROUP BY tags_id) d ON t.id = d.tags_id
WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.fleet, t.model, t.load_capacity

tsbs_iot.name: daily-activity
tsbs_iot.description: Per fleet, model and day, the share of the day trucks were active.
tsbs_iot.sql:
SELECT t.fleet, t.model, y.day, sum(y.ten_mins_per_day) / 144.0 AS daily_activity
FROM tags t
JOIN (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '24 hours', time) AS day, date_bin(INTERVAL '10 minutes', time) AS ten_minutes, tags_id, count(*) AS ten_mins_per_day
      FROM diagnostics
      GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
      HAVING avg(status) < 1) y ON y.tags_id = t.id
WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.fleet, t.model, y.day
ORDER BY y.day
tsbs_iot.tuned:
SELECT t.fleet, t.model, date_bin(INTERVAL '24 hours', y.ten_minutes) AS day, sum(y.ten_mins_per_day) / 144.0 AS daily_activity
FROM tags t
JOIN (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 minutes', time) AS ten_minutes, tags_id, count(*) AS ten_mins_per_day
      FROM diagnostics
      GROUP BY 1, 2
      HAVING avg(status) < 1) y ON y.tags_id = t.id
WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.fleet, t.model, date_bin(INTERVAL '24 hours', y.ten_minutes)
ORDER BY day

tsbs_iot.name: breakdown-frequency
tsbs_iot.description: Per model, how many times trucks broke down: ten-minute windows where most diagnostics report a fault after a window where they didn't.
tsbs_iot.sql:
WITH breakdown_per_truck_per_ten_minutes AS (
    SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 minutes', time) AS ten_minutes, tags_id,
           sum(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / count(*) >= 0.5 AS broken_down
    FROM diagnostics
    GROUP BY 1, 2
), breakdowns_per_truck AS (
    SELECT ten_minutes, tags_id, broken_down,
           lead(broken_down) OVER (PARTITION BY tags_id ORDER BY ten_minutes) AS next_broken_down
    FROM breakdown_per_truck_per_ten_minutes
)
SELECT t.model, count(*)
FROM tags t
JOIN breakdowns_per_truck b ON t.id = b.tags_id
WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL AND b.broken_down = false AND b.next_broken_down = true
GROUP BY t.model

iot_point.name: one-truck-last-hour
iot_point.description: One truck's raw readings of the last hour.
iot_point.sql:
SELECT time, latitude, longitude, velocity, fuel_consumption
FROM readings
WHERE tags_id = 1 AND time >= CAST('2026-01-03 23:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND time < CAST('2026-01-04 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

iot_point.name: one-truck-all-history
iot_point.description: One truck's every reading, in time order.
iot_point.sql:

FROM readings
WHERE tags_id = 1
ORDER BY time

iot_point.name: one-truck-latest
iot_point.sql:

FROM readings
WHERE tags_id = 1

iot_point.name: one-truck-hourly-avg
iot_point.description: One truck's average speed and highest fuel consumption per hour over all its history.
iot_point.sql:

FROM readings
WHERE tags_id = 1
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

iot_point.name: fleet-last-hour-avg

tsbs_devops.name: double-groupby-1

tsbs_devops.sql:

FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hostname ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM cpu) AS c
WHERE rn = 1

tsbs_devops.name: groupby-orderby-limit

iiot.name: latest-area
iiot.description: Dashboard: the latest value and quality of every tag in an area (1,000 tags).
iiot.sql:
SELECT r.tag, r.time, r.value, r.quality
FROM readings r
JOIN (
    SELECT r2.tag AS tag, max(r2.time) AS last
    FROM readings r2 JOIN tags t ON r2.tag = t.tag
    WHERE t.area = 'A000' AND r2.time >= now() - INTERVAL '2 hours'
    GROUP BY r2.tag
) m ON r.tag = m.tag AND r.time = m.last
WHERE r.time >= now() - INTERVAL '2 hours'
iiot.tuned:
SELECT l.tag, l.time, l.value, l.quality
FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tag ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM readings) l
JOIN tags t ON l.tag = t.tag
WHERE l.rn = 1 AND t.area = 'A000' AND l.time >= now() - INTERVAL '2 hours'

iiot.name: recent-machines
iiot.description: Dashboard: the last 15 minutes of two machines' tags, raw.
iiot.sql:
SELECT tag, time, value
FROM readings
WHERE (tag LIKE 'M00001.%' OR tag LIKE 'M00002.%') AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
ORDER BY tag, time

iiot.name: trend-30d
iiot.description: Trend chart: one 1-second tag over 30 days, as hourly min, max and mean (720 points).
iiot.sql:
SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS hour, min(value) AS lo, max(value) AS hi, avg(value) AS mean, count(*) AS samples
FROM readings
WHERE tag = 'M00007.pressure' AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time)
ORDER BY hour

iiot.name: alarm-window
iiot.description: Investigation: every tag of five machines, raw, 10 minutes either side of an alarm two hours ago.
iiot.sql:
SELECT r.tag, r.time, r.value, r.quality
FROM readings r JOIN tags t ON r.tag = t.tag
WHERE t.machine >= 'M00010' AND t.machine <= 'M00014'
  AND r.time >= now() - INTERVAL '130 minutes' AND r.time < now() - INTERVAL '110 minutes'

iiot.name: shift-report
iiot.description: Report: per machine of a line and analog signal, the hourly mean and peak over the last 8 hours (one shift).
iiot.sql:
SELECT t.machine, t.signal, date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', r.time) AS hour, avg(r.value) AS mean, max(r.value) AS peak
FROM readings r JOIN tags t ON r.tag = t.tag
WHERE t.line = 'L0003' AND t.kind = 'analog' AND r.time >= now() - INTERVAL '8 hours'
GROUP BY t.machine, t.signal, date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', r.time)
iiot.tuned:
SELECT t.machine, t.signal, h.hour, h.mean, h.peak
FROM (
    SELECT tag, date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS hour, avg(value) AS mean, max(value) AS peak
    FROM readings
    WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '8 hours' AND tag IN (SELECT tag FROM tags WHERE line = 'L0003' AND kind = 'analog')
    GROUP BY tag, date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time)
) h JOIN tags t ON h.tag = t.tag

iiot.name: daily-stats
iiot.description: Report: per tag of a line and day, the sample count and mean over 30 days.
iiot.sql:
SELECT r.tag, date_bin(INTERVAL '24 hours', r.time) AS day, count(*) AS samples, avg(r.value) AS mean
FROM readings r JOIN tags t ON r.tag = t.tag
WHERE t.line = 'L0002' AND r.time >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY r.tag, date_bin(INTERVAL '24 hours', r.time)
iiot.tuned:
SELECT tag, date_bin(INTERVAL '24 hours', time) AS day, count(*) AS samples, avg(value) AS mean
FROM readings
WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND tag IN (SELECT tag FROM tags WHERE line = 'L0002')
GROUP BY tag, date_bin(INTERVAL '24 hours', time)

iiot.name: time-above-limit
iiot.description: Process: per pressure tag in the area, seconds above its alarm limit in the last 24 hours.
iiot.sql:
SELECT tag, sum(CASE WHEN value > hi THEN next_t - t ELSE 0 END) AS seconds_above
FROM (
    SELECT r.tag AS tag, r.value AS value, t.hi_limit AS hi, date_part('epoch', r.time) AS t,
           lead(date_part('epoch', r.time)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.tag ORDER BY r.time) AS next_t
    FROM readings r JOIN tags t ON r.tag = t.tag
    WHERE t.area = 'A000' AND t.signal = 'pressure' AND r.time >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
) AS s
WHERE next_t >= t
GROUP BY tag
iiot.tuned:
SELECT r.tag, integral(r.time, r.value > t.hi_limit) AS seconds_above
FROM readings r JOIN tags t ON r.tag = t.tag
WHERE t.area = 'A000' AND t.signal = 'pressure' AND r.time >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY r.tag

iiot.name: time-weighted-avg
iiot.description: Process: per temperature tag of a line, the time-weighted mean over the last 24 hours (samples weighted by how long they held).
iiot.sql:
SELECT tag, sum(value * (next_t - t)) / sum(next_t - t) AS twa
FROM (
    SELECT r.tag AS tag, r.value AS value, date_part('epoch', r.time) AS t,
           lead(date_part('epoch', r.time)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.tag ORDER BY r.time) AS next_t
    FROM readings r JOIN tags t ON r.tag = t.tag
    WHERE t.line = 'L0004' AND t.signal = 'temperature' AND r.time >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
) AS s
WHERE next_t >= t
GROUP BY tag
iiot.tuned:
SELECT tag, time_weighted_mean(time, value) AS twa
FROM readings
WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND tag IN (SELECT tag FROM tags WHERE line = 'L0004' AND signal = 'temperature')
GROUP BY tag

iiot.name: uptime
iiot.description: OEE: per machine of a line, the share of the last 7 days it was running (an on-change state tag).
iiot.sql:
SELECT machine, sum(CASE WHEN value = 1 THEN next_t - t ELSE 0 END) / sum(next_t - t) AS running_share
FROM (
    SELECT t.machine AS machine, r.value AS value, date_part('epoch', r.time) AS t,
           lead(date_part('epoch', r.time)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.tag ORDER BY r.time) AS next_t
    FROM readings r JOIN tags t ON r.tag = t.tag
    WHERE t.line = 'L0000' AND t.signal = 'state' AND r.time >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
) AS s
WHERE next_t >= t
GROUP BY machine
iiot.tuned:
SELECT t.machine, time_weighted_mean(r.time, r.value = 1) AS running_share
FROM readings r JOIN tags t ON r.tag = t.tag
WHERE t.line = 'L0000' AND t.signal = 'state' AND r.time >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY t.machine

iiot.name: energy
iiot.description: Energy: per machine in the area, kWh used in the last 24 hours, from cumulative counters that may reset.
iiot.sql:
SELECT machine, sum(CASE WHEN value >= prev THEN value - prev ELSE value END) AS kwh
FROM (
    SELECT t.machine AS machine, r.value AS value, date_part('epoch', r.time) AS t,
           lag(r.value) OVER (PARTITION BY r.tag ORDER BY r.time) AS prev,
           lag(date_part('epoch', r.time)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.tag ORDER BY r.time) AS prev_t
    FROM readings r JOIN tags t ON r.tag = t.tag
    WHERE t.area = 'A000' AND t.signal = 'energy' AND r.time >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
) AS s
WHERE prev_t > 0
GROUP BY machine
iiot.tuned:
SELECT t.machine, sum(c.kwh) AS kwh
FROM (
    SELECT tag, counter_diff(time, value) AS kwh
    FROM readings
    WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND tag IN (SELECT tag FROM tags WHERE area = 'A000' AND signal = 'energy')
    GROUP BY tag
) c JOIN tags t ON c.tag = t.tag
GROUP BY t.machine

iiot.name: gaps
iiot.description: Data quality: per 1-second pressure tag, gaps over 5 minutes in the last 24 hours (sensor or gateway down).
iiot.sql:
SELECT tag, count(*) AS gaps, sum(next_t - t) AS gap_seconds
FROM (
    SELECT tag, date_part('epoch', time) AS t, lead(date_part('epoch', time)) OVER (PARTITION BY tag ORDER BY time) AS next_t
    FROM readings
    WHERE tag LIKE '%.pressure' AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
) AS s
WHERE next_t - t > 300
GROUP BY tag
iiot.tuned:
SELECT tag, gap_count(time, INTERVAL '5 minutes') AS gaps, gap_seconds(time, INTERVAL '5 minutes') AS gap_seconds
FROM readings
WHERE tag LIKE '%.pressure' AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY tag
HAVING gap_count(time, INTERVAL '5 minutes') > 0
